# std.ranges

`Range<D>`, the value `lo..hi by step` (R01.8.4), and the `[]` of a run of keys: `s[a..b]` is a view of `s`, `r[a..b]` of a range a range again. Core re-exports `Range` and the `[]` fns, so no module imports them. `std.range` has the algorithms over ranges.

Import: `use std.ranges.{...}`.

## `struct Range<D: Domain>`

`lo..hi by step` as a value: `n` values from `lo`, `step` apart.

Fields: `lo: Int`, `n: Int`, `by: Int`.

## Functions

- `fn range_of<D: Domain>(lo: Int, hi: Int, step: Int) -> Range<D>` — `lo..hi by step`; empty when `lo` is past `hi` (R04.4.29).
